name: example-claude-animation
title: Hand-painted Motion
description: A 5-second, 16:9, silent hand-painted character film: an editable Motion source painted with p5.brush and John Heibel's MIT painting/timeline toolkit, plus the rendered MP4.

description_i18n.en: A 5-second, 16:9, silent hand-painted character film: an editable Motion source painted with p5.brush and John Heibel's MIT painting/timeline toolkit, plus the rendered MP4.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 5 秒、16:9、无声的手绘角色动效：交付可编辑、可回放的 Motion 源码（p5.brush 与 John Heibel 的开源绘画/时间轴引擎）和导出的 MP4。
description_i18n.zh-TW: 5 秒、16:9、無聲的手繪角色動效：交付可編輯、可回放的 Motion 原始碼（p5.brush 與 John Heibel 的開源繪畫/時間軸引擎）和匯出的 MP4。

query.en: Make a 5-second silent hand-painted cartoon of an original rounded teal bird meeting a butterfly in a sunny garden. Landscape 16:9, with an iris opening and closing, a surprised reaction and a happy bounce.
query.zh-CN: 制作一个 5 秒、16:9、无声的手绘动画：一只原创的圆润青色小鸟在花园里遇到蝴蝶，从惊讶到开心地跳起来，开头和结尾使用圆形转场。

exampleOutputs.title: A little bird meets a butterfly
